title: Aspire Nautilus 3 Tank 2ml
description: The Aspire Nautilus 3 is a successor to a truly legendary tank. The 2ml Nautilus 3 Tank offers an adjustable airflow with seven airflow inlet holes ranging from 0.8mm to 3mm, providing unparalleled control to let you find your ultimate draw. Easy to refill, the Nautilus 3 features a convenient top-fill system. The Nautilus 3 is also compatible with all of Aspire’s celebrated Nautilus series coils and Triton coils, enabling you to explore a huge variety of MTL and DL, sub-ohm vaping styles, and all the coils are easy to replace thanks to the tank’s press-coil installation feature. Its 510-connection means that you can pair the Nautilus 3 tank with almost any compatible mod. A legend reborn, the Aspire Nautilus 3 Tank is a fantastic successor to one of the most influential vape tanks ever made. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
